title: The Peace Discount
summary: Oil gives back a week of war premium on three hours of US–Iran talks, the CFTC tells prediction markets that betting on what people say is presumptively riggable, and an Ohio pensioner allegedly GPS-tagged a delivery driver to find the Pokémon restock.
